messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Multilevel Latent Class Analysis. Please help me.
parts:
Hi Fritzie,

I don’t know the answer to your question, but MplusAutomation definitely does not help you run Mplus if you don’t have the software. You might take a look at OpenMX, which is the best R SEM package for mixtures that I’m aware of, and it also supports multilevel estimation.

Best,
Michael

messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Multilevel Latent Class Analysis. Please help me.
parts:
Hi Fritzie,

It would be more programming, but you could also consider Stan:  http://mc-stan.org/

It is a Bayesian estimator and can handle mixtures of distributions and almost any model you can fully specify (including multilevel).  There is a good R package linking to Stan called, rstan.  Its all open source and free so cost would not be an issue.

Best regards,

Josh
